texts: Heath Ledger did not appear in the TV show "Full House". The show, which aired from 1987 to 1995, starred John Stamos, Dave Coulier, Candace Cameron-Bure, Jodie Sweetin, and Mary-Kate and Ashley Olsen.

Heath Ledger played the role of Danny Tanner's eccentric cousin, a free-spirited musician named "Ranger", in the TV movie "Full House: The Next Generation", a direct-to-video sequel that aired in the early 2000s.

Heath Ledger played the character of "The Man" in Full House, an American sitcom that aired from 1987 to 2003. He portrayed the character for five seasons and was known for his distinctive voice and performance.

Heath Ledger played the character of Cody Tanner, a charismatic and free-spirited cousin who moved in with the Tanner family for a season. Cody quickly became a fan favorite with his laid-back attitude and quirky sense of humor. He provided a contrasting perspective to the family’s more structured environment, often giving DJ, Stephanie, and Michelle advice on life's unpredictability. Ledger's performance added a new dynamic to the show, bringing a blend of both dramatic and comedic elements to his character.
